## `half` — Half of an amount, rounded down

Takes `amount` `:integer`

Returns [`amount`](../../../values/amount.md), or nothing

- **`rounded_down`** — An odd amount loses its last grosz
  - `half(5)` returns `2`
  - `half(4)` returns `2`

- **`nothing_of_one`** — One grosz halves into nothing
  - `half(1)` returns `nil`
